summary: A chair explains why the board can vote on individual islands while their collective name is still pending.
realLife: Ranieri asked to hear the Maine island names together. The chair proceeded with the individual proposals because a future meeting might lack a quorum.
inGame: needs: the individual and collective proposals, the meeting attendance and the chair’s ruling.

turns.what: The chair calls the individual names.
turns.writesBack: The group name stays pending after their vote.

turns.what: The clerk carries the items forward.
turns.writesBack: The names await a meeting that can act.
